site.name: ExpertsIA
site.description: AI consulting agency for startups, SMEs and corporations. AI strategy, agentic workflows, RAG systems, data science, training. Based in Bordeaux, France, working with clients across France and remotely.

actions.name: Request an AI consultation
actions.description: Send a project inquiry to ExpertsIA: AI audit, agentic automation, RAG systems, data science, or team training. Response within 24 business hours. No account required.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Project or question: what to automate, audit, or build with AI

actions.notes: The hidden website field must stay empty (anti-spam honeypot).

actions.name: Subscribe to the newsletter
actions.description: Subscribe to the ExpertsIA newsletter on AI automation for business. Occasional emails, unsubscribe anytime. No account required.

actions.name: Book a free 15-minute AI audit call
actions.description: Book the free diagnostic call with Cyril Marchand via Cal.com to discuss an AI project before engaging.

actions.name: Request a paid AI site teardown
actions.description: Agent-callable API: structured 7-pass teardown of any website (clarity, pricing, SEO/GEO, CRO, differentiation, monetization, action plan). Paid via the x402 protocol (USDC on Base) or with an API key.

payment.fallback: Authorization: Bearer <API key> for non-x402 integrations

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL of the site to tear down, max 2048 chars

actions.notes: First call without payment returns HTTP 402 with payment terms. Retry with the X-PAYMENT header after settling.
